name: silliness
quote: Are you suggesting that coconuts migrate?
description: Perception that someone's behavior is harmless, but way outside the bounds of normal thought or behavior to the point of risking their status as a serious person.

variations.name: wrong headed
variations.description: Judging that someone's out-of-bounds behavior lowers their dignity to the point of losing respect for them.

variations.name: desire to lift someone's mood
variations.description: If you are the person trying to make someone else laugh, you may be willing to trade some dignity to make it happen.
examples: making funny faces for a sick child

variations.name: admiration of silliness
variations.description: Judging that someone's potential loss of dignity from an attempt at lightening another's mood actually elevates your respect for them.

commentaries.quote: Most of the time we carefully curate the dignity of important identities. Sometimes a dash of silliness can be a part of that equation.
Children have one kind of silliness, as you know, and grown-ups have another kind.

conditions: Perception that someone's behavior is harmless, but way outside the bounds of normal thought or behavior.
The person is perceived as risking their status as a serious person.
